checks.query: MATCH (g:Gene {id:$gene})<-[r:PART_OF_QTL_SIGNAL]-(n:snv) RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS id

review_requirements: Answer the specific requested scope; disclose unavailable or incomplete categories.

Preserve typed identities, recorded assay/tissue distinctions and provenance; a verified empty result is valid.
